description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSkillDao class, which provides data access methods for EmployeeSkill and Skill entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching EmployeeSkill objects, as well as fetching allowed skills for employees. The class leverages Doctrine ORM for database interactions and extends a base DAO class.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to EmployeeSkill and Skill entities, including CRUD operations and filtered searches within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeSkill entity into the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeSkill entity based on employee number and skill ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSkill entities for a given employee based on a list of skill IDs; returns the number of deleted records.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeSkill entities matching specified filter parameters, returning an array of EmployeeSkill objects.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeSkill entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Retrieves an array of Skill entities that are allowed for an employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed skills for an employee based on search filter parameters.
